description: The NITROX II CN2460 is one member of the Cavium Networks awardwinning NITROX, NITROX Lite, and NITROX II line of security processors.Based on a common hardware processor core, the NITROX families deliver50Mbs to 10Gbps of encryption bandwidth with 1K to 40K RSA/DH operationsper second. NITROX processors and acceleration boards are being used byserver-motherboard vendors and OEMs in a wide range of networkingequipment to accelerate security protocols and algorithms.
